verdict.rationale: RevenueCat models access as Entitlements tied to Products, so apps don't hard-code product identifiers (revenuecat-docs-1, revenuecat-docs-8). Apps check access at runtime through the SDK's CustomerInfo object and getCustomerInfo() (revenuecat-docs-3, revenuecat-docs-13, revenuecat-gh-1), and server-side endpoints can grant entitlements (revenuecat-docs-19). Missing for 10: modeling of numeric limits or quotas (not just boolean access), an explicit statement that CustomerInfo exposes active entitlements, documentation of a server-side REST entitlement check, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
